description: Deterministic CREATE2 addresses for Aethelred contracts. Predicted via script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy. Same addresses on every chain that hosts the canonical CREATE2 deployer (0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C).
notes: Before the first real broadcast, `deployed.<chain>` is empty.
Production broadcasts MUST produce tx hashes matching the `predicted` addresses — any mismatch means the deployer salt or init code changed.
TS client packages read this file via packages/rpc-adapters/src/deployments.ts.
For local Foundry testing (forge test), no deployment is needed — the Forge suite instantiates contracts directly in `setUp()`.
